name: box-jump
instructions:
1. Setup in an athletic base position with your knees slightly bent and your arms hanging loosely by your sides.
2. Squat down with a countermovement to slightly above 90 degrees, swing your arms back, and explode up towards the box by driving off both legs.
3. Generate triple extension and then land with both feet on a box and absorb the impact with your legs.
